summary: Improve an existing solved parametric design through isolated changes, solver-backed comparison, hard-constraint checks, and finite accept-or-rollback evidence.
triggers: An existing solved CAD or CAE design has editable parameters and explicit targets.
One parameter change should be rerun through the same solver setup and compared with baseline.
A design iteration needs attribution, rollback, credibility, and a finite budget.
antiTriggers: Author a new multi-part model from scratch.
Compare surrogate or critique output directly with solver evidence.
Claim physical safety, manufacturability, or optimality from CAD or one simulation.

provenance.note: Candidate source read in full and independently rewritten for the portable product; no candidate prose was copied.
Baseline, one-change attribution, solver credibility, rollback, and bounded termination semantics informed the product entrypoint.
The comparison's parameter, solver, and finite-loop patterns were consulted; no candidate performance result is promoted.
